name: ai-knowledge-inbox
description: A minimal AI Knowledge Inbox: save notes and URLs, then ask questions over them with a cited RAG pipeline.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "node --watch --import tsx server/src/index.ts" "vite web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
